source_text.GH#2699: PR 2 of #2697: aggregate route moves to the shared restricted-field walker. Code gate.

task.description: SECURITY-REVIEWER CODE gate for GH #2699 (commit 172ac4208). Read-only; no lib/ or test/ edits.

result.summary: CODE VERDICT: PASS. Scope IN (tenant-data path, INV-2 on aggregate route); #2612 trigger NOT fired (diff touches only routers/entities.ex, a compiler.ex doc comment, design doc, handoffs). VERIFIED in lib/letflow/routers/entities.ex run_query_aggregate/4 (L2200-2215): build_aggregate_request -> FieldPolicy.check_request(%{user_id,prefix}, :aggregate, request, %{exempt?: false}) -> Compiler.run_aggregate; guard runs strictly before any compile/Repo call. principal built only from auth_context user_id and prefix!(conn) (INV-1). Walker (request_guard.ex) registry aggregate == [:entity_type,:aggregates,:group_by,:filters,:join] = exactly what build_aggregate_request emits; unknown key or malformed element fails closed to :request_clause_unwalked; join_refs tags every hop (near and far) with its declaring owner_entity_type and fk_field, restriction_entity_types loads a set for each; unloaded set counts as restricted. Presence oracle (INNER join drops null/absent fk rows) closed: restricted fk, nullable or through-far, refuses 403 before compile. ERRORS: {:error,:request_field_restricted|:request_clause_unwalked} fall through render_aggregate_error catch-all to render_query_error L2660 which returns Response.forbidden with the identical string the deleted aggregate clause used (byte-identical 403, INV-5; no field/entity/clause name). All join_relations_error members (too_many_joins, join_depth_exceeded, duplicate_join_target, field_not_allowed, no_through_relation, ambiguous_through_relation, entity_type_not_found, invalid_schema_name) have render_query_error clauses or the INV-8 catch-all; no bare match added. 404 ORDER: Compiler.join_relations runs check_join_shape then ensure_primary_exists (Allowlist.fk_defs) before resolve_all_raw_relations, so ghost primary + join -> entity_type_not_found 404 before no_through_relation, same as cross-tenant; ghost primary without join -> empty set, guard passes, compile_aggregate Allowlist.load -> 404 as before. compile_aggregate also runs check_join_shape first, so shape errors are identical on both paths. Error-order change (restricted + invalid join -> join 4xx) leaks nothing: join errors derive from definitions, not grants; accepted in design. DELETED HELPERS: grep of lib/ and test/ for aggregate_field_restricted, check_aggregate_field_restrictions, aggregate_request_field_names finds no remaining use (only a stale prose mention in test/letflow/routers/entities_query_restricted_filter_test.exs:6 docstring, non-functional). FieldGrants alias still used elsewhere in the router, so no unused-alias warning. Other Compiler.run_aggregate callers unchanged (no Compiler logic change; only a doc comment). Permitted requests: guard returns {:ok, _} and flow is unchanged; extra cost is one load_restrictions per involved entity type. NOTE (non-blocking): dangling sentence in the router comment above render_aggregate_error ('The one member with no row-query analogue at all.' L2312-2313) is cosmetic; design R1-R3 (test A-8/A-9 byte-identical and nullable/far-hop coverage, PR body text on #2700/TypeAccess, 403-vs-422 split, join-error-before-403) still bind TEST-DESIGNER and the PR body. Tests not run (read-only, hosted CI).
